objective: Implement governed Open-Meteo and Nominatim contextual enrichment without creating a second research, policy or authority boundary.

rulesConsidered: Context providers are advisory enrichment resources only.
Nominatim public service is policy-constrained to <=1 request/sec with identifying User-Agent/optional Referer and caching.
Nominatim remains swappable and is not a distributed/bulk geocoding substrate.

notes: Nominatim rejects unsupported URL-like credentials only through HTTP policy; no secrets are required.
Caching and rate limiting reduce accidental public-service abuse.

changes: Added typed weather and geocoding contracts.
Added Open-Meteo /v1/forecast adapter with coordinate and query-variable validation.
Added Nominatim /search and /reverse adapter with application User-Agent, optional Referer, process serialization and caching.
Added deterministic normalization and policy tests.
Updated external API registry, environment/documentation and .okf ledger.
verificationPlan: Require CI + Team Change Gate before merge.
Keep live proof separate and obey provider policies.
Use a separately provisioned geocoding provider for distributed or regular high-volume workloads.
notes: Nominatim public-server limits are treated as a hard integration policy, not a suggestion.
Open-Meteo is implemented as enrichment, not research truth.
